Hi Marissa / Monica —

Per our leadership sync: BrightSide is asking for a single package we can hand them by the end of next week that includes manager summaries for FY27 Q1, a one-page OKR rollup, and any flagged notes that require redaction before external sharing. I started a combined workbook (attached) with three tabs: manager summaries, calibrated ratings, and redaction flags.

Requests:
- Marissa: can you fill rows 10–35 on the "manager summaries" tab with your direct reports' short bullets (3–4 lines each) by Wed 3/24 EOD?
- Monica: please validate calibration notes and mark any PII or sensitive coaching content on the "redaction flags" tab; add recommended redactions or suggested language to replace the flagged text.

BrightSide emphasized they want something shareable with their PeopleOps but sensitive coaching items must be redacted from the external packet. I looped Claire from BrightSide in for any clarifying Qs.

Attachments: manager_notes_q1.xlsx (workbook)

Thanks — I’d like to compile and run a quick sanity check before sending to BrightSide.

Karthik

Thanks — quick status:

- I reviewed the redaction flags tab. Devon R. entry has PII-level detail. I recommend redacting the paragraph and replacing with: "Manager is executing a documented development plan; progress will be re-evaluated next cycle."
- Flagged two more entries (rows 21 and 29) that reference medical leave dates — redaction suggested to remove dates and keep high-level context only.
- I attached a brief internal guide with examples of acceptable replacement language (sensitive-flag-redaction-guide.docx).

Also: before we send anything externally, we should confirm with BrightSide which artifacts they actually need. If they only want the OKR rollup and non-sensitive manager summaries, we can avoid sending the full workbook. Claire — can you confirm the level of detail PeopleOps wants?

Monica
People Operations
Redwood Inference
